incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: Metering alert: token-count drift detected for prod-eu emitter cluster. 3 customers showing +20-40% token delta versus reported usage. Auto-triggered at 15:04 UTC.
lee (sre): i'm oncall, looking at emitter queues and consumer lag. assigning to myself.
maria (oncall): seeing delayed kafka commits on consumer group `metering-ingest-eu` around 15:00-15:06. partition 4 spike.
emily (billing): heads up — a few customers got transient overage flags; i'll pause alerts if needed. which metric should i mute?
lee (sre): pause `overage-notifier-prod` for eu tenants for 15m while we triage. emily want me to do it?
emily (billing): pls do. i'll notify CS about potential false positives.
ops-bot: Ran: /runbook mute-overage-alarms --env prod --region eu -> OK
rajesh (infra): linking dashboard: https://dash.redwood/prod-eu/metering/emitters?span=5m
lee (sre): quick check: emitter write rates steady, but consumer processing time jumped. tailing consumer logs:
```
2024-05-12T15:01:23Z consumer-4 WARN commit timeout for offset 1234567
2024-05-12T15:02:11Z consumer-4 ERROR reprocess failure: org.apache.kafka.common.TimeoutException
2024-05-12T15:03:45Z consumer-4 INFO resumed after retry
```
rajesh (infra): we rolled a small config change to the consumer autoscaler earlier at 14:50 — reverting now.
maria (oncall): rolling revert in progress, ETA ~3m. i'll monitor lag.
lee (sre): meanwhile, i'm running an ad-hoc reconciliation query to compare emitter vs billed tokens for the affected window:
```
SELECT SUM(emitted_tokens) AS emitted, SUM(billed_tokens) AS billed
FROM metering.events
WHERE region='eu' AND ts >= '2024-05-12T14:50:00Z' AND ts < '2024-05-12T15:10:00Z'
GROUP BY customer_id
HAVING emitted > billed * 1.2
LIMIT 10;
```
lee (sre): sample result shows customer `acme-inc` emitted 1.2M vs billed 900k -> ~33% delta.
emily (billing): okay, keep overage alerts muted. i'll mark these customers as "investigating" in support tracker and draft a note.
ops-bot: Revert completed: consumer-autoscaler config -> previous (hash: b4c9) -> OK
rajesh (infra): consumer lag dropping now. looks like reversion fixed retry/backoff behaviour.
maria (oncall): lag back to normal for partitions 0-6, partition 4 cleared at 15:12.
lee (sre): running quick backfill for the ~20m window to replay missing commits to billing pipeline. kicking off job `metering-backfill-eu-170850`
ops-bot: Job started: metering-backfill-eu-170850 -> job_id: jb-99823
lee (sre): backfill progress: 10% ... 50% ...
lee (sre): backfill completed at 15:28. reconciliation query now shows emitted vs billed within <2% for sample customers.
emily (billing): re-enabling overage notifier for eu, but with a 10m suppress window on historic deltas to avoid churn.
emily (billing): sent CS templated note to affected accounts: "We detected an internal metering delay earlier today that may have triggered false overage alerts. We corrected the issue and backfilled usage. No billing adjustments expected; contact us if you see discrepancies."
rajesh (infra): opening a postmortem with root cause: autoscaler change caused transient consumer timeouts. will include deployment diff and s3 of logs.
maria (oncall): assigning follow-ups: consumer autoscaler gating; add canary for config rollouts; improve alert to include commit-lag metric.
lee (sre): closing pager. summary: mitigation=rollback + backfill; customer impact=transient false overage flags (muted), no permanent billing deltas after backfill.
incidents-bot: Incident resolved and pager closed at 15:30 UTC. Follow-up: postmortem needed within 48h. :white_check_mark:
